scenarios.description: Quick Mode on a dense-signal prospect produces 3-5 angles with verdicts, evidence chains, and 2+ data points per signal cluster.
assertions: output.section_generated_angles contains between 3 and 5 rows inclusive
every row in output.section_generated_angles has a verdict in the set {'ALPHA', 'PROMISING', 'INTERESTING', 'COMMODITY'}
every row in output.section_generated_angles attributes to at least one of the 5 §3 forcing function names
every cluster in output.section_signal_clusters has at least 2 data points
every data point in output.section_signal_clusters carries an inline source URL
every row in output.section_generated_angles with verdict 'ALPHA' or 'PROMISING' has a matching entry in output.section_shelf_life_block with all three sub-fields
output frontmatter contains mode: quick and omits situation_mining_source

scenarios.description: Deep Mode picked but no situation-mining artifact less than 14 days old — skill's first response is the verbatim halt message and zero WebSearch calls fire.

input.mocked_filesystem: no match for docs/research/situations/example-city.gov-*.md less than 14 days old

assertions: first_response contains the exact string: 'Deep Mode requires situation-mining output less than 14 days old for'
first_response contains the exact string: 'Run `situation-mining` first, then resume.'
first_tool_calls does NOT contain any WebSearch call
no artifact is written to docs/research/angles/
skill does NOT silently fall back to Quick Mode (no Quick Mode Step 1 queries fire)
skill response does NOT contain any of the four verdict labels (ALPHA / PROMISING / INTERESTING / COMMODITY)

scenarios.description: Every ALPHA (and PROMISING) angle must have all three shelf-life sub-fields — estimate citing a shelf-life-patterns.md decay category, decay trigger, and refresh date.
assertions: every row in output.section_shelf_life_block has a non-empty 'estimate' sub-field
every 'estimate' sub-field cites exactly one of: 'Regulatory / Deadline', 'Competitive Move', 'Data Insight', 'Industry Pattern', 'Structural'
every row in output.section_shelf_life_block has a non-empty 'decay_trigger' sub-field with a specific named event (not 'when it becomes common knowledge' or similar generic phrasing)
every row in output.section_shelf_life_block has a 'refresh_date' sub-field matching ISO date format YYYY-MM-DD
every ALPHA row in output.section_generated_angles has a matching row in output.section_shelf_life_block
every PROMISING row in output.section_generated_angles has a matching row in output.section_shelf_life_block
no COMMODITY or INTERESTING row appears in output.section_shelf_life_block

scenarios.description: Angle scored below 4.0 gets verdict COMMODITY with action 'Discard entirely' and is NOT carried forward to the Generated Angles output or any downstream handoff.

mocked_scored_angles.name: Generic cold pitch about holiday lighting value

assertions: output.section_generated_angles row for the scored-below-4.0 angle has verdict == 'COMMODITY'
output.section_handoff_block references the angle name with action 'Discard entirely' OR 'discarded'
the COMMODITY angle does NOT appear in output.section_shelf_life_block
the COMMODITY angle does NOT trigger a handoff to email-copywriting
the COMMODITY angle does NOT produce a file at docs/content/ideas/
zero COMMODITY rows in output.section_handoff_block are marked 'carry forward' or 'ship'

scenarios.description: Deep Mode run with a valid situation-mining artifact in context — output §Worldview Conflicts block contains at least 1 conflict framed as a curiosity opening, not a gotcha.

mocked_situation_inferences: Stated worldview: 'AI-first operations' (per CEO LinkedIn posts)
Contradicting signal: 50 manual data-entry roles currently listed on careers page

assertions: Read tool call fires on 'docs/research/situations/example-hotels.com-2026-04-15.md' during Deep Mode Step 1
output.section_worldview_conflicts contains at least 1 row
every row in output.section_worldview_conflicts contains the substring 'Stated:' AND 'Evidence:' AND 'Curiosity opening:'
no row in output.section_worldview_conflicts contains gotcha framing substrings ('caught you', 'you claim X but actually', 'exposes', 'contradicts yourself')
every Curiosity opening sub-field is phrased as a question (ends with '?')
output frontmatter contains situation_mining_source pointing to the artifact path

scenarios.description: All 5 forcing-function names appear in the output artifact exactly as spelled in creative-thinking-models.md §1–§5 headings — invented aliases fail.
assertions: Read tool call fires on 'plugins/marketing/references/creative-thinking-models.md' to cross-check spelling
output contains 'Inversion (Munger)' exactly (not 'Munger Inversion')
output contains 'Adjacent Transfer' exactly
output contains 'Timing Arbitrage' exactly
output contains 'Specificity Escalator' exactly
output contains 'Ecosystem Gap Analysis' exactly
output does NOT contain invented aliases: 'Munger Inversion', 'Adjacent Industry Transfer', 'Timing Window', 'Specificity Ladder', 'Ecosystem Analysis'
